notes.ortho: Positional orthology from unique flanking sequence (>=80% identity, >=200 bp), single best hit per target assembly. "Orthologous to" lists distinct partner assemblies then the total partner-locus count.
notes.flag: 28 catalogue loci annotated by arbitration, plus the 7 uncatalogued candidates (not catalogue members). 1 is a seed/rescan contradiction (the rescan scored another family >=20 bits above the seed; the seed family is retained). The rest are close-margin calls (margin below 15 bits) or loci without a seed.
notes.full: Every locus (627, all 6 assemblies) with its sub-subfamily call and both flanks' cross-assembly orthology status (ssearch36, >=80% identity, >=200 bp, single best hit per target assembly). L/R badges show each flank's class; the double tick marks loci in a partner pair supported by both an L- and an R-sourced hit.
